messages:
alex: Heads up — deployed v3.5.0 to prod at 2024-11-12 12:10 UTC (change window). Noticing a canary->prod push for embeddings route. Anyone on call?
qa_raj: Seeing error rate jump to 18% on /v1/embeds in usw2. Stack traces show OOMs on embed-worker-3.
sre_tom: deploy-bot suggests autorevert if error_rate>5% for 3m. Current conditions met.
deploy-bot: (bot) Autorevert proposal: revert to v3.4.2; reason=embedding OOMs; confidence=0.92. Manual approval required.
maria: Prefer manual rollback during quiet window vs a rushed hotfix. Hotfix could introduce kernel regressions.
alex: Agree manual rollback. Need ops to execute and devex to draft customer note.
ops_lin: On call — preparing rollback plan. We'll pin to v3.4.2 and shift traffic back to stable pool.
ops_lin: Runbook step 1: `deploy rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope=usw2 --graceful` step 2: monitor p95 and error_rate for 10m.
devex_julie: I'll open a release-notes PR and draft a short blurb for the status page + #cust-notify.
maria: Also add a migration note: embeddings model pinned to quantized build to avoid OOMs while we investigate.
ops_lin: Executing rollback now.
ops_lin: `> deploy rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope=usw2 --graceful`
ops_lin: initiated — draining canary and shifting traffic, ETA ~3m.
qa_raj: Post-rollback check: errors dropping, p95 halved in the last 60s :thumbsup: 
alex: Great. Maria, Julie — coordinate on release notes and announce to #cust-notify once stable.
devex_julie: Draft ready: "Rolled back v3.5.0 to v3.4.2 due to elevated embed errors; investigating root cause. Customers on embeddings routes may have experienced errors between 12:10-12:16 UTC."
maria: Adding action item: repro under load, check KV cache and memory allocation; tagging infra for kernel/driver checks.
sre_tom: Opening incident INC-2024-1125 and assigning to infra. Will attach logs and metrics.
ops_lin: Marking change window as completed once we confirm. I'll update the status page and link incident in the cust-notify post.
alex: Thanks all. Postmortem with rollback timeline and any learnings (canary thresholds, kvcache limits) — please add to the incident. Closing thread after notes posted."
